``` ## In one paragraph I'm interested in the problems where a clean dataset, a clear business question and a messy real-world constraint collide. That combination is where my Allied World underwriting work, my BAA1027 Machine Learning research on shopper intent, the EcoEnergy profitability dashboard and my BAA1003 capstone on PriceBeo all sit. Business analytics as a discipline is less about running more models and more about asking the right question, building the evidence carefully, and communicating the result so that a decision can actually be made. That is the lens I want to take into a graduate role. ## How I work ```{=html}
01
Question before model
Every analytical project starts with what decision the analysis is supposed to support. My ML research paper concluded that the classification threshold (a decision rule) mattered more than the classifier choice; that finding changed how I think about applied analytics.
02
Report the negative results
Two of the three methodological innovations in my research paper did not work. I reported both in the main narrative rather than burying them. Negative results strengthen an argument by locating the positive one more precisely.
03
Translate, do not summarise
My CTO role on PriceBeo taught me that translating between technical and commercial teams is not the same as summarising. It means restating trade-offs in the language the other side uses, so that a joint decision can be made.
04
Discipline scales
The habits that make competitive bodybuilding work (consistent inputs, honest measurement, long horizons, no shortcuts) are the same habits that make analytical work trustworthy. I try to operate the same way in both.
``` ## Skills ```{=html}

Applied in BAA1027 ML research paper: 12,205 sessions, five classifiers tuned via GridSearchCV, cost-sensitive threshold optimisation, SHAP interpretability audit. Every project page in this ePortfolio uses executable Python chunks.

DCU Database Systems coursework. Designed the six-table PostgreSQL backend for PriceBeo. Queried and reconciled account data at Allied World.

EcoEnergy Corp profitability dashboard: star schema, DAX KPIs (YoY, MoM, rolling 12-month, cost per unit), region-to-product drill-through, and a 3-year predictive model projecting a turnaround from a €8.46M net loss to €3.09M annual profit.
Web development (Quarto, HTML, CSS, SCSS, WordPress)

Competitive bodybuilding
Training seriously since 2021. The sport teaches you that consistent inputs beat bursts of effort, that honest measurement is non-negotiable, and that meaningful change happens on horizons longer than most people will tolerate. I apply the same principles to analytical work; patience with a dataset tends to produce better answers than aggression with it.
Hiking and running
Weekend trails around Wicklow and further afield when time allows. The combination of distance and elevation is a good antidote to screen time and produces the kind of quiet thinking space that problem-solving actually requires.
Community volunteering
Volunteered in Czestochowa, Poland in 2021 and 2022 on community service initiatives. Worth it for the shift in perspective that comes from working alongside people in circumstances quite different from your own.
